blends.name: Create Golden Badge
blends.desc:
### The gold badge is the best and gives you the opportunity to earn serious money just by owning it. The owners of these badges automatically participate in the drawings that take place on Twitter. And also owners will be able to participate in free drops on NeftyBlocks.
#### You can read about the capabilities of all badges here:
1. Plastic Badge: Allows you to participate in drops on NeftyBlocks.
2. Wooden Badge: Gives a 10% discount on drops for NeftyBlocks from the VoxelArtPics collection.
3. Silver Badge: Gives you access to drops before anyone else
4. Golden Badge: Allows you to participate in free drops, and all NFT data holders are automatically entered into the giveaways.

*Upgraded badges inherit the features of the previous badge.*
